articles.title: ‘Forest Guard’ Creates a Buzz on Aha, Trends Among OTT Viewers
articles.description: The survival thriller ‘Forest Guard’, featuring Kathir, Shine Tom Chacko, Hakeem Shajahan, Sudhi Koppa, Sreekanth Murali and Jeo Baby in prominent roles, is currently receiving strong attention on Aha. Directed by MC Joseph and produced by Rajasekhar Annabhimoju, the film has music composed by Sooraj S. Kurup. Released theatrically last year, ‘Forest Guard’ has now arrived on Aha and is already trending on the streaming platform. The film’s intriguing premise, forest backdrop and suspense-driven narrative have helped it grab the attention of OTT audiences. The entire story unfolds in a forest, where a secret meeting takes an unexpected and dangerous turn. What follows is a series of twists and tense situations that keep the audience guessing. Set largely over the course of a single night, the film maintains an atmosphere of suspense as the protagonist Mithun finds himself fighting for survival. Betrayal changes the course of Mithun’s night, leaving him trapped in a dangerous situation where trusting the wrong person could cost him everything. The mystery surrounding whom he can trust and how he will escape forms the core of the story. Kathir delivers a natural and intense performance as Mithun, while Shine Tom Chacko emerges as one of the film’s biggest highlights. The combination of their performances, particularly in their tense confrontation, adds considerable weight to the thriller. The forest locations and atmospheric presentation further complement the story, while Sooraj S. Kurup’s music contributes to the tension and mood of the proceedings. With its gripping setting, unexpected twists and strong performances, ‘Forest Guard’ is currently emerging as an interesting watch for thriller lovers on Aha. Cast Kathir, Shine Tom Chacko, Hakeem Shajahan, Sudhi Koppa, Sreekanth Murali, Jeo Baby and others Technical Crew Director: MC Joseph Producer: Rajasekhar Annabhimovju Music: Sooraj S. Kurup
